# What we can't say

Doefin is registered in Port Louis, Mauritius, and is for professional investors only. Anything that invites someone to trade counts as a financial promotion, and those are tightly regulated. So:

- Don't write for retail readers. Avoid "anyone can trade", "for everyone" and "beginners".
- Never post a return, a profit figure or a past trade's gain. Avoid "profit from", "earn", "guaranteed" and "risk-free".
- Say miners hedge with Doefin only when you can name them. Otherwise say what difficulty does to them: "about 5.6% fewer coins for the same machines".
- Never call anything "AI-powered". Forecasting difficulty is arithmetic.
- Give every number that can change a dated source. Mark anything single-source or a judgement as such.
- End anything public about Doefin markets with the disclaimer: Doefin is for professional investors only. Positions involve risk. Nothing here is investment advice.
- Anything public about Doefin or its markets needs written approval from Raffaella Tenconi, our regulatory adviser, before it goes out. That includes a single post. Ask her for the full checklist.
